{{Top|leg}}
The '''Assistant-Minister of Corrections''' was the deputy to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Minister of Corrections]] in the [[Imperial Correctional Facilities Ministry]]. [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Chawkroft]] held the post before ascending to the position of Minister of Corrections.
